template.label: Alert template
template.webHint: Crash loop, 5xx rate, slow responses, CPU and a 99.9% availability SLO.
template.failed: Could not add the recommended rules
template.noChannel: No notification channel is connected, so these rules only show in alert history until you attach one.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Hold warning and info alerts during a daily window and send them when it ends if they are still firing. Critical alerts always notify.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.description: Threshold, crashloop, certificate expiry, scheduled task failure, domain health, and missing backup rules over this app's metrics, restarts, jobs, domains, and backup schedules. Notifies via webhook, Slack, or Discord on a firing/resolved transition.
rules.emptyDescription: Get notified the moment a metric crosses a threshold or a container starts crashlooping, via webhook, Slack, or Discord.

slo.title: Track a {{target}}% availability SLO
slo.detail: This app is serving traffic and has no SLO alert. A {{target}}% target pages you when the 30 day error budget burns fast and opens a ticket-level alert when it burns slowly.
slo.noChannel: No notification channel is connected yet, so the rule will only show in alert history until you attach one.
slo.createFailed: Could not create the SLO rule.

domain_traffic_drop.label: Domain traffic drop
domain_traffic_drop.help: Fires when requests in the window fall below a share of the same window yesterday. It stays quiet until there is enough traffic yesterday to compare against.

parked_domain_cert_expiry.label: Parked domain certificate expiry
parked_domain_cert_expiry.help: Fires when a parked domain has fewer days of certificate left than the limit. Covers every parked domain on the platform.

trafficKinds.scopeHelp: Watch every domain of this app, or just one.
trafficKinds.windowHelp: How long a stretch to compare with the same stretch yesterday. 0 to 24h.
trafficKinds.percentHelp: Fires when traffic is below this percent of yesterday. 50 means half.
trafficKinds.minRequestsHelp: Skip the check when yesterday had fewer requests than this, so quiet domains do not alert.
trafficKinds.daysHelp: Fires when a parked domain's certificate has fewer days left than this.
